meta.title: Improve lab data loading and update efficiency
meta.body_summary: Enable lazy loading on sample management table and update patient report saving to persist only changed values.

perf_labels.notes: Small PR enabling lazy load and selective saving; merged within minutes without review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 25 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a minimal performance tweak PR that merged almost instantly without review, consistent with a low-risk, self-merge outcome.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or human feedback was given; only a bot comment noted that auto-review was skipped because the base branch is not the default branch. Author self-merged without external verification.
review_details.performance_claim: Lazy loading improves table rendering efficiency; saving only changed values reduces database write overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Extremely small change with no review; merged by author immediately, showing that for trivial perf improvements the agent can deliver successfully but without any maintainer verification or performance evidence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or before/after metrics supplied; only narrative claims of improved efficiency.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression handling occurred; the PR was merged without any reported issues.

core_change_summary.description: In PatientReportController.java, changed saving logic to persist only changed values instead of always overwriting; in sample_management.xhtml, added lazy loading attribute to the data table.
change_trajectory: Single commit (cb8add5) combined both changes: added lazy loading in the XHTML table and refactored the controller to conditionally set report values.

review_signals.summary: CodeRabbit auto-review was skipped because the base branch is not the default branch.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created and merged by the author within ~6 minutes; no human reviewer was involved; a bot noted that review was disabled for this branch.
